equivalence_contract: Same detection multisets (including legacy weak/PUA evidence), verdict, layer traversal and policy holds. Selected final name and alert order may differ. Full mode preserves original ordered results.
retained_targets: all except proven plain PE-only NDB/LDB callback-name groups
evidence_policy: Preserve original bytes and metadata in a private immutable intake object; derivatives have independent verdicts. Narrative submission must proceed independently. Holds have an authorized full-scan/manual exception path, including executable evidence.
known_limits: Callback coverage and corpus agreement are not proof of complete parsing. Silent parser/embedded-size skips prevent automatic-release qualification. Alert order differences are accepted only with equal detection multisets and severity; first-hit and early-stop/trust callbacks are outside the restricted configuration.
